title: TDD: FlintBridge (global.__flint__ CDP interface)
description: TDD. Write failing tests first. Exposes registry on global.__flint__ in dev mode. Every function returns a string. Tests: exposes readScreen/getScreen/getSchema/callTool/invokeAction on global.__flint__, readScreen returns string, callTool returns 'ok' for valid/'error: unknown tool' for invalid, invokeAction returns 'ok'/'error: action not found', cleanup removes global.__flint__, does not expose when __DEV__ is false.
